title: Dangerous Goods Acceptance: administration fee on an approval
content:
## When this applies
Under the Dangerous Goods Acceptance product, the administration fee falls due from the state of an acceptance's records when an acceptance under review is approved. This policy sets the administration fee of an approval; it governs no other decision.

## Business effect
The administration fee is booked in the same act as the approval, as a charge on the acceptance's dangerous-goods account dated on the approval date, and it raises the charges the acceptance owes.

## Handling
The fee is passed with the recording of the approval through the desk's review-decision action; the amount passed is the administration fee this policy sets for that approval.

## Basis Q&A
- *Does this policy decide whether the goods are approved?* No; it sets only the administration fee of an approval.
- *Is an administration fee booked with a rejection?* This policy concerns approvals only; it sets the fee of an approval.
